messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Government and Legal Affairs" as it appears in the following examples.
['According to South African Law, at the expiration of 5[five] years, the money will revert to the ownership of the South Africa Government if nobody applies to claim the fund.', 'I can present you as the Next of Kin, and we will work out the modalities for the claiming of the funds in accordance with the law.', 'Your student loan account need to be upgraded to match the details we hold on record for you.', 'After the last annual calculations of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of $83.80.', 'According to the British law at the expiration of 8 (eight) years, the money will revert to the ownership of the British Government if nobody applies to claim the fund and the eight years is the end of july2005.', 'To indicate your interest, contact my lawyer urgently and confidentially for more information and the roles you will play in this business.', 'We would like to notify you that you still have an outstanding tax refund of 198.54 from overpaid tax from year 2015/2016, despite our previous letters regarding your refund we are yet to receive your claim.', 'I got your contact from an email directory and decided to contact you for assistance.', 'my husband is in jail now, his bank accounts and private properties including crude oil export refinery have been confiscated by the sultanate.', 'We are writing to inform you that we have received instruction that your Affidavits of funds claim document that was presented to this office yesterday by your Attorney, Richard Wilsonian Regards to Mrs. Sarah Oliver Will of $12,000,000.00 (Twelve A Million United States Dollars) has been approved by our head administer...', 'You have received a tax refund payment of 302.25GBP from HMRC (HM Revenue & Customs) into your Internet Banking Account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
